__comment: Floating bottom dock layout (macOS-dark-mode style). Array order = on-screen order, left to right. Loaded by the UIRegistry autoload (res://scripts/registries/UIRegistry.gd) — no other script should read this file. Scope: dock LAYOUT only (order, emoji, label, tooltip, action binding). The action *logic* lives in GDScript (the dock node's dispatch map), never here. Buildable-entry catalogs (costs, action_type, requires_floor) are a separate concern and are not part of this file.
__emoji_note: Emoji icons require an emoji-capable fallback font in the project theme (e.g. Noto Color Emoji). Godot's default theme font will NOT render them. Godot 4 supports color-glyph fonts (COLR/CPAL, CBDT/CBLC, sbix) once one is loaded.
